_about: SHELF of Camões's Lusiads in English before 1931, the translations no other shelf holds: Fanshawe (1655), Musgrave (1826), Quillinan (1853, books I-V), Mitchell (1854), Aubertin (1878-84, with the Portuguese) and Duff (1880). Mickle's (1776) is on singles-medieval-epic and Burton's (1880) on burton. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 102); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. 'mitchell' and 'duff' alone are left out as common surnames.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
